about: Each change to frozen bridge code against the merge base, with one reason: moved (a rule moved into Rust, naming its task), refactor (behaviour kept) or gone (an entry that left the freeze). Entries the merge base already holds are spent and may be pruned.

packages/structured-data-models-client/s.moved: T1.32a: the entities' cast to the key's type moved into the core (sdm_engine::keys::cast); the bridge's table of the key types it cast to (_ARROW_TYPES) and its key_type refusal (_not_taken) are deleted, and it imports math for the host's own missing values

T1.32a: the cast to the key's type with pandas (pd.Series(indices, dtype=...)) and its INVALID_REQUEST and INTERNAL_ERROR split are the core's rule table; the bridge hands over the values as pyarrow infers them, or as their text where it infers no one type

T1.32a: the entities are passed to the core without the schema or the entity's name, which only the bridge's cast read
